propositions: workflow_ms exposes only an aggregate interval that hides constituent operations, preventing performance diagnosis and expectation-setting.
Completion workflow call path must be decomposed into concrete, non-overlapping subphase boundaries that sum to workflow_ms without residual or instrumentation side effects.
Subphase durations must be emitted by the completion sidecar alongside existing aggregate fields while maintaining backward compatibility with older sidecars.
Instrumentation must perform only monotonic in-process clock reads at existing seams without adding LLM calls, Git work, filesystem snapshots, network requests, retries, or other material work.
New subphase metrics and their arithmetic reconciliation to workflow_ms must be verified by automated CI coverage.
